scenicChapters.title: Col de Turini
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 72 km this is Col de Turini, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

nice-c-te-d-azur-mercantour-high-roads-a.story: 785 km from Ospedaletti to Olivetta San Michele, about 14 h 16 of riding. The stops in between: Cuneo, near Sambuco, near Draguignan and Cagnes-sur-Mer. The climbs: Antibes, Théoule-sur-Mer, Cap-d'Ail and Ospedaletti. It tops out at about 2,100 m. It crosses Italy, France and Monaco - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules.

scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 24 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
